notes:
Access route: direct fetch returned HTTP 403 (Akamai); curl_cffi with the chrome124 desktop profile got 200 on the first try and carried the whole run (r.jina.ai was 403 under batch contention and was not needed). Platform: IBM WebSphere Commerce PWA with an Unbxd search layer (body class 'view-UnbxdBodyView'). Category tree taken from the site's own nav API /JSONAPIs?module=categories (full tree with categoryIds) and cross-checked against SiteMap_CAT_001-004_v2.xml (397 category URLs). Counts come from the site's OWN first-party proxy https://www.frontgate.com/UnbxdAPI?categoryId=<id>&returnRespAsJSON=true&isAPI=true&requesttype=ajax -> numberOfProducts. This is the exact value the PLP header renders (main.js binds totalNumberOfProducts -> 'VIEW {N} ITEMS', text property ITEMS_LABEL). Per the batch rule I did NOT trust the structured number on code-reading alone: every one of the 13 leaf rows was verified empirically twice - (a) full enumeration by paging &unbxdStart in 100-row pages, which returned exactly numberOfProducts tiles and then stopped, and (b) a boundary test returning 1 tile at unbxdStart=N-1 and 0 tiles at unbxdStart=N. No divergence anywhere. Deliberately EXCLUDED: all outdoor nodes per assignment (Outdoor Lighting 48, Outdoor Wall Art 81, Outdoor Decor, Outdoor Entertaining 85, Garden Decor & Fountains, Lanterns & Lighting, Planters, all outdoor furniture); the entire Bed & Bath and Furniture trees; Botanicals (Wreaths & Greenery / Plants & Trees / Florals - faux botanicals now out of scope); Holiday Decor & Gifts; Rugs & Pillows, Curtains, Blankets & Throws, Table Linens (textiles); Flatware (cutlery); Barware & Wine Accessories 36 (bar tools - shakers, tongs, openers, stoppers); Bar Cabinets & Carts (furniture); Home Solutions (ladders, mats, covers, storage); Clearance/Sale/New Arrivals/Best Sellers/Discover nav pages. JUDGEMENT CALLS: (1) 'Candles & Home Fragrance' (11) dropped - I read all 11 titles: 8 are scented/fragrance (LAFCO Core Collection, LAFCO Room Mist, LAFCO Reed Diffuser, 4x Voluspa scented candles, Voluspa Reed Diffuser), leaving only 2 candleholders and 1 unscented pillar candle, and both candleholders are already counted inside Objects & Trays. (2) 'Glasses & Stemware' (36) dropped as a re-cut: product-ID comparison showed 31 of its 36 items (86%) sit inside Drinkware (46), so emitting both would double-count; the broader Tabletop > Drinkware node is kept. (3) 'Rechargeable Lighting' (22) dropped as a re-cut by power source: 16 of 22 IDs already appear in Table & Desk Lamps (9), Floor Lamps (4) and Wall Lighting & Sconces (3). (4) 'Entertaining Collections' (70) dropped - a 'Collections' roll-up per the never-extract list. (5) 'Fireplace & Hearth' (14) dropped - 11 fireplace screens plus tool sets and a wood holder; primary purpose is hearth hardware, so skipped rather than guessed. (6) 'Beverage Dispensers & Serving Dishes' (42) and 'Charcuterie Boards & Accessories' (35) kept: I read every title; both are predominantly serveware (trays, platters, servers, dispensers, boards, snack bowls), with roughly 6-7 bar-tool/knife items mixed in. Frontgate publishes no clock category. Parent roll-ups (Lighting 207, Indoor Decor 276, Wall Art & Mirrors 277, Tabletop 106, Serveware 128) are left as parent rows with null qty since their children overlap and they also bundle out-of-scope children.

RULE 0 TOP-UP ADDENDUM (2026-08-10): The original pass's own assignment explicitly told the worker to skip ALL outdoor nodes, which was wrong under Rule 0 for outdoor LIGHTING and outdoor WALL ART/decor (product type beats room name) - only outdoor FURNITURE should have been excluded. Re-fetched the site nav tree via /JSONAPIs?module=categories (curl_cffi chrome124, 200 OK) and cross-checked SiteMap_CAT_001-004_v2.xml. Added 3 rows, each verified by the same double method as the original 13 (full paged enumeration of unique productIds + boundary test at N-1/N): (1) Lighting > Outdoor Lighting, categoryId 222685, qty 48 - direct sibling of the already-extracted Lighting rows under parent categoryId 222167. (2) Wall Decor & Mirrors > Outdoor Wall Art, categoryId 222672, qty 81 - direct sibling of Wall Art/Mirrors under parent categoryId 222161. (3) Lighting > Lanterns & Lighting (Outdoor Decor tree), categoryId 222692, qty 70 - a second, room-tree branch (Outdoor > Outdoor Decor) documented as a Rule 0.6 'two genuine nav branches' case: productId comparison showed 47/70 overlap with Outdoor Lighting (222685) and 48/48 of Outdoor Lighting's own items are covered by it bar one, but 23 of its items are unique real lighting SKUs (pendants, sconces, post lights, lanterns, LED items) not present anywhere else in this file, so it was kept rather than deduped. DEDUPED/EXCLUDED (checked, not added): 'Outdoor Wall Art' under the Outdoor tree itself (categoryId 194215, /outdoor/decor-accessories/outdoor-wall-art/, qty 49) - productId comparison showed 48 of its 49 items (98%) are already inside the added Outdoor Wall Art row (222672, 81 items), i.e. a near-duplicate listing of the same category under a second URL per Rule 0.6, so it was dropped and only the larger 222672 node kept. 'Garden Decor & Fountains' (categoryId 223203, qty 29) - reviewed every title: overwhelmingly garden statuary, fountains, and birdbaths (Corsini Water Fountain, Aged Limestone Sentry Lion, Cirrus Stone Birdbath Fountain, etc.), not lighting/mirror/wall-decor; one 'Medallion Outdoor Clock' is in-scope on its own but the category as a whole is a garden-ornament/water-feature branch outside this top-up's lighting/mirror/decor scope, so left out. CHECKED FOR BATH/VANITY LIGHTING AND MIRRORS (per brief): confirmed via the full category tree dump that Frontgate has NO dedicated Bathroom Lighting, Vanity Lighting, Bathroom Mirror, or Vanity Mirror category node anywhere in the site nav (grepped categories.json for bathroom-light/vanity-light/bathroom-mirror/vanity-mirror/wall-mirror and all returned false) - only 'Bathroom Vanities' and 'Vanity Stools' exist, and both are furniture (already correctly excluded). However, individual mirror/sconce SKUs are embedded (mixed with robes, towels, hardware, countertop trays) inside two Bed & Bath > Bath 'Bathroom Accessories' listings that have no dedicated mirror/lighting sub-page: categoryId 198233 (/bed-bath/bath/bathroom-accessories/, 25 items total) contains 'Zadro LED Cordless Dual-sided Mirror', 'LED Articulating Rechargeable Vanity Mirror', and 'Frontgate Resort Collection(TM) LED Vanity Mirror' (3 of 25); categoryId 226665 (/whats-new/resort-collection/bath-accessories/, 21 items total) contains 'Frontgate Resort Collection(TM) Wall Mirror', the same LED Vanity Mirror, plus 'Frontgate Resort Collection(TM) Double Sconce' and 'Single Sconce' (4 of 21, overlapping the first). Confirmed the site's f_type_uFilter=Vanity+Mirror facet parameter is NOT honored by the UnbxdAPI endpoint (returns all 25 unchanged), so there is no canonical filtered URL to extract an exact qty against; not added as a row per 'never estimate, never invent a qty against a non-existent sub-category URL' - flagging here as MANUAL REVIEW: 2-4 in-scope mirror/sconce SKUs exist inside Bed & Bath > Bath > Bathroom Accessories with no dedicated listing page, qty deliberately left uncounted (null candidate). Verification method for all 3 new rows and all overlap checks: curl_cffi chrome124 impersonation on frontgate.com/UnbxdAPI with header CBI-AJAX:1, identical to the route used for the original 13 rows.
